summary: Design agent completed Low-Level Design for NFR-MAINT-002 (Issue #38) — TypeScript strict mode enforcement for LegoBuilder. LLD covers tsconfig.json strict flags, ESLint no-explicit-any rule configuration, shared type definitions (brick.ts, scene.ts, commands.ts, project.ts), CI pipeline steps (tsc --strict --noEmit + eslint --max-warnings 0 + grep belt-and-suspenders), pre-commit hooks (husky + lint-staged), error handling patterns (catch unknown, branded types, generics over any), security considerations (safe JSON parsing, no @ts-ignore), and measurable NFR targets (0 errors, 0 violations, ≥99% type coverage). Draft PR is open on branch feature/38-nfr-maint-002-design awaiting Gate 6a human design review.
